title: euodia tietaensis
intro: Euodia tietaensis, commonly known as Brazilian angelica tree, is a plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Euodia tietaensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of the plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
